threads.body: The public extension API method `InstrumentationModule.isIndyModule()` is removed here, but the contributor docs still reference it (e.g. `docs/contributing/writing-instrumentation-module.md` around the “Indy modules and transition” section). After this change, that documentation becomes inaccurate/misleading for extension authors and should be updated/removed in the same release/PR series (also consider whether an explicit changelog entry for the removal is needed, since `CHANGELOG.md` currently only mentions the deprecation).
